parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS tid, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.status, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(t.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS end_date, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tournament_matches m WHERE m.tournament_id = t.id AND m.status IN ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED')) AS played, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'sort_order', d.sort_order, 'format', d.format, 'group_count', d.group_count,   'qualify_per_group', d.qualify_per_group, 'entries', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.id) FROM tournament_entries e WHERE e.division_id = d.id AND e.status = 'APPROVED')))  FROM tournament_divisions d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS divisions FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 WHERE t.code = $2
